headline: Unusual Options Activity: Kraft Heinz Trader Bets Big on a Bull Call Spread — With Low Risk, Big Reward

headline: JPMorgan upgrades Kraft Heinz credit to Overweight on deleveraging outlook
summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan upgraded its credit recommendation on Kraft Heinz to Overweight from Neutral, citing better-than-expected quarterly results, disciplined balance sheet management and greater confidence that the packaged food maker can fund higher investment in its brands while keeping leverage under control.

headline: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Is Down 6.8% After Massive Impairment-Fueled Loss Amid Ongoing Turnaround Investments
summary: Kraft Heinz recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$6,262 million and a net loss of US$5,460 million, largely driven by very large goodwill and intangible asset impairment charges, while also affirming a regular US$0.40 quarterly dividend and completing a US$1.51 billion share repurchase program.
